title: nixos/LANraragi: Add openFirewall option
targets_toml: TOTAL NON-DISCOVERY: option_prefix=[services,lanraragi], watch=[openFirewall] gave 0 discovered_options despite discovered_predicates correctly finding 'enable's mkIf predicate. Retried at option_prefix=[services], watch=['lanraragi.openFirewall'] -- still 0 discovered_options, both base and head identical (OptionNotFound both sides, 'unchanged'). The module declares its options via `options.services = { lanraragi = { ... }; };` (one dotted segment 'services', then a NESTED attrset for the leaf module name 'lanraragi') -- a THIRD declaration-shape variant distinct from both the fully-dotted `options.services.lanraragi = {...}` (which usually resolves fine, e.g. photoprism/olivetin/hedgedoc) and the fully-nested `options = { services.lanraragi = {...}; }` documented earlier. Logging as new raw data for the 'blackout' dataset -- NOT asserting this is the cause, since prior fully-dotted and fully-nested variants have both shown inconsistent results too.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Total non-discovery, both sides identical ('unchanged'). See targets_toml self-correction note for the declaration-shape observation.
